sees: frame 1: an angry-looking man in a dark top inside a red circle labelled THREATENS; beside him a phone/battery-like gauge labelled PULSE, nearly empty (small dark bar at bottom)
frame 2: an arrow curves from the red circle to the PULSE gauge, which is now filled about two-thirds, with a dashed line near the lower-middle
frame 3: same as frame 2, gauge filled to the same level above the dashed line, arrow still shown
changed: the PULSE gauge went from nearly empty to mostly full, with an arrow linking the threatening man to it
cause: the man's threat, shown by the arrow from him to the gauge
effect: pulse rises past a threshold (dashed line); the threat raises the heart rate
message: A threatening person makes your pulse spike.
wouldConfuse: A fuller gauge usually reads as good or charged, so a rising pulse could be misread as positive; the dashed threshold line is unexplained.

sees: frame 1: a woman in a white coat with a bun and a stern, worried face fills the right side, a younger man partly in front of her looks ahead; bold text 'REVIEWING EVERY DIAGNOSIS' on the left, a hospital bed and clock in the background
frame 2: the man has moved up and to the right, overlapping her more; a small brown triangle shape appears near her eye and at the right edge
frame 3: the man is further right and slightly larger, the triangle shape is at the upper right; text unchanged
changed: the two characters shift position slightly (camera or character drift); nothing meaningful changes
message: Doctors double-check every diagnosis, with a colleague looking on.
wouldConfuse: The odd brown triangle shapes near the eyes look like glitches or a nose; it is unclear who is the doctor and who is the patient, and the crowded overlap is awkward.

sees: frame 1: a young woman in a grey hoodie, head tilted, worried face, on a beige background with diagonal stripes and grey circles; no text
frame 2: same woman; faint grey text 'LET THE MACHINE DECIDE' fades in at upper right
frame 3: the text is now bold, dark and fully visible, with 'DECIDE' highlighted in orange

cause: narration emphasising the phrase; text animating in
effect: the viewer's attention goes to the phrase while the woman looks uneasy
